name: Local Search
description: Search the offline library — local Wikipedia (ZIM) archives and the user's own notes and documents — and return the most relevant text. Use it for encyclopedic facts or anything in the user's files, with no internet.

query.description: Search terms, a phrase or an article title, e.g. 'photosynthesis'

path.description: Folder (searched recursively) or single file. Defaults to the shared library ~/myagent/library/; relative paths resolve in the workspace.

lang.description: ZIM archives only: language edition, e.g. 'en' or 'it'. Default: all of them.
